note: Upstream skill sets boring-stack builds on. Each is installed by reference from its own repository at the adopted commit and never copied here. `boring-stack update` moves `adopted` forward only when the safety scan is clean and the gate passes; `hold: true` keeps a provider where it is. Our own skills are not providers: they change by pull request.
